transport_basis: L0B5 exact-query transport probe returned HTTP 200 without reading or accepting a response body; this plan is a fresh no-retry discovery run after the zero-data L0B2 endpoint-state stop.
scope: Public bibliographic and repository metadata only. No article full text, supplementary file, measurement table, affinity value, structure file, FORT label, .env credential, or model API may be read. OpenAlex is projected to the minimal candidate-identification fields id, DOI, and title; the runner may retain and serialize only its fixed approved bibliographic fields.
eligibility_rule: A candidate is countable only when metadata explicitly supplies a verified accepted open license and an explicit post-firewall scaffold-diverse query-ligand count of at least 40. Title wording, abstract snippets, total file count, total compound count, citation count, and inferred scaffold diversity do not satisfy the count rule.
deduplication_rule: Collapse records by normalized DOI, then by source-specific persistent identifier. Do not infer provenance links from numerical measurements.
